title: American Stephen Hubbard Freed After More Than 4 Years In Russian Custody
content: Russia has released 74-year-old US citizen Stephen Hubbard, who had been detained since 2022. He had been sentenced to prison for allegedly acting as a mercenary in Ukraine, charges his family disputed. President Vladimir Putin announced Hubbard’s release during talks with US envoy Steve Witkoff.

title: Amid Russia's Onslaught, A Twist In The Pursuit Of Men Fleeing Ukraine For Moldova

title: Funeral Held For Five Children From One Ukrainian Family Killed In Russian Strike In July
content: A funeral was held in Radushne in Ukraine's Dnipropetrovsk Region on October 19 for five children from one family who were killed in an air strike on July 30. Their burial was delayed as investigators used DNA analysis to identify the victims. Five other family members had already been laid to rest.
